title: APIKeyCreateInput
description: An object sent to create an API key.

name.description:
The name for this API key. Use the name to describe the purpose of
the key.

user_role.description:
The role of this API key. Cannot be greater than the role of the
user account. Defaults to the user account role when `null`.

expires_at.description:
Optional timestamp (in [RFC 3339](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3339)
format) indicating when the key expires. After this time, the key
can no longer authenticate and is removed automatically. Must be in
the future. Omit or set to `null` for a key that never expires.
